fields.label: Product Line
fields.description: The product line this rule serves. A rule matches a lead only when every axis it names matches.
The account this grain dials out on, and the account its numbers belong to unless a row below overrides it.
fields.label: Telephony Account

fields.description: The numbers patients dial to reach this grain. An inbound call on a number listed here is attributed to this grain; a call on a number listed nowhere is dropped, which is what keeps another business's traffic off a shared provider account out of this CRM. Left empty, the rule is outbound-only. Label names the number for people and routes nothing. Account Override is set only when a number sits on a different provider account from the one this rule dials out on. Open a row with the pencil for the full note on each column.
fields.label: DIDs (Direct Inward Dialing numbers)
